name: Stone-cornered office tower (abandoned)
description: Abandoned and overgrown: Slim seven-storey office tower on a 16 x 12 m plan: limestone-clad corner piers and spandrels with projecting pilasters, bronze-framed window bands between, a stone base course and a deep cornice. Lobby and back office on the ground floor; six office floors round a core of stairs, lift and toilets; a stair to a roof door, a parapet, rooftop units and a water tank.
